option.helptext: Mod-specific mutations will output their logic to the message log. Useful for finding issues.
Characters who gain Earthen Barrage begin with Take Stones already enabled, sculpting and equipping stones automatically. Does not change the toggle on existing characters.
When disabled, Geomancy is removed from character creation and from new mutation draws. Characters who already have it are unaffected. Takes effect at the next new game or save load.
